rules.title: San Francisco Annual Allowable Rent Increase
rules.quote: Allowable Rent Increase: 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.summary: The allowable rent increase in San Francisco is 1.6% for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

rules.title: San Francisco Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.quote: Security Deposit Interest: 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.summary: Security deposits in San Francisco must earn interest at a rate of 4.2% for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

rules.title: San Francisco Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, or Capital Improvement Evictions
rules.quote: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation Date of Service of Notice of Termination of Tenancy ("Eviction Notice") 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 Relocation Amount Due Per Tenant $8,245.00 Maximum Relocation Amount Due Per Unit $24,733.00 PLUS Additional Amount Due for Each Elderly (60 years or older) or Disabled Tenant or Household with Minor Child(ren) $5,497.00
rules.summary: For no-fault evictions based on owner or relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation with notices served March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027, landlords must pay $8,245 per tenant (maximum $24,733 per unit), plus $5,497 for each elderly, disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; max $24,733.00 per unit; +$5,497.00 for elderly/disabled/minor children
rules.effective_date_evidence: Date of Service of Notice of Termination of Tenancy ("Eviction Notice") 3/01/26 – 2/28/27
rules.coverage_text: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: San Francisco Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.quote: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act Date of Service of Notice of Termination of Tenancy ("Eviction Notice") 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 Relocation Amount Due Per Tenant $11,110.05 Maximum Relocation Amount Due Per Unit $33,330.13 PLUS Additional Amount Due for Each Elderly (62 years or older) or Disabled Tenant $7,443.90
rules.summary: For Ellis Act evictions with notices served March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027, landlords must pay $11,110.05 per tenant (maximum $33,330.13 per unit), plus $7,443.90 for each elderly or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; +$7,443.90 for elderly/disabled
rules.effective_date_evidence: Date of Service of Notice of Termination of Tenancy ("Eviction Notice") 3/01/26 – 2/28/27
